references.text: Jesus predicts his death and resurrection for the first time, which is a direct precursor to the event described in Matthew 20:17.
Jesus again predicts his suffering, death, and resurrection to his disciples, which is closely linked to his conversation with them in Matthew 20:17.
Jesus predicts his death and resurrection to the disciples, parallel to the event in Matthew 20:17.
Jesus' entry into Jerusalem, which is the destination of the journey he begins in Matthew 20:17.
The prophecy about the Messiah's sufferings in Isaiah, which Jesus' predictions in Matthew 20:17 and the parallels refer to.
Psalm 22, which prophetically describes the suffering that the Messiah will undergo, something Jesus refers to in his predictions.
